correctness.rationale: Exact Q0/Q2/Q3 polynomial identities are derived by enumerating factor endpoints. Second finite differences of Q0 reconstruct the four unordered zero-run lengths (including zero entries); normalized Q3 recovers the unordered endpoints by their sum and product; the factorized Q2 difference distinguishes all remaining non-reversal assignments. Burnside counts exactly the reversal classes. Independently replayed finite cases: 1,820 gap tuples, 17,550 weight-three words, 4,096 orientation tuples, and a published weight-four witness. No finite check is treated as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Full substring-composition reconstruction is a cited inverse problem with nontrivial ambiguity. This all-n classification locates the first permitted Hamming weight where nonreverse ambiguity becomes possible, shows that a whole measurement channel is unnecessary for three markers, and gives an explicit inverse and exact orbit census. It is a motivated structural threshold rather than a routine fixed-n computation; the known weight-four example is not passed off as novel.
